segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced oil production, shrinking blackheads/pores, and glowy (not greasy) results, though some still report breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split between those who found the pads too drying without a follow-up moisturizer and those who saw dry patches clear up with no dryness at all.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer in her mid-30s reports fewer breakouts, smaller-looking pores, and a smooth, glowy (not oily) finish.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided: several describe itching, burning, redness, or bumps, while others (including one with rosacea-adjacent concerns and one with redness/bumps) report no irritation at all.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 50s finds the formula too astringent, and another in her 40s reports firmer, more youthful-looking skin and improved hydration.

concerns.aging: One reviewer (mid-40s) reports firmer, more youthful-looking skin after a couple of weeks; another over-55 reviewer finds the formula too astringent for her skin.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note the pads are drying and require a moisturizer afterward, sometimes causing initial dryness before adjusting use; others with dry skin report no dryness and even improved dry patches.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report new redness, itching, or blotchiness (some tied to rosacea or sensitive skin), which subsided once use stopped; other sensitive-skin reviewers report redness improving with use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer warns against daily use, arguing it disrupts the skin's natural barrier and recommends spacing applications every two to three nights; another reviewer combining it with retinal experienced burning and itching.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of post-acne red/dark marks and hyperpigmentation, in some cases within a single use; one notes scars lightening several shades overnight.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers describe reduced breakouts, cleared cystic and hormonal acne, and fewer clogged pores over weeks of use; however, a substantial minority report sudden painful or cystic breakouts, some attributing it to purging and others to a negative reaction.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report visibly reduced oil production and a matte, non-greasy finish after regular use.

aspects.libelle: Purging or new breakouts early on

extraits.texte: I have oily, sensitive, monthly hormonal cystic acne, and post inflammatory hyperpigmentation, easily clogged pores, type skin. This has been an absolute game changer. Within a week my pores shrunk and within 2 weeks I have to shove a mirror in face to even find my pores. Oil production has significantly reduced. After 2 months use, my skin has never looked this good, in combo with other Medicube products. Amazing!

extraits.titre: Did not work for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I really wanted this product to work for me, as I've seen it used in conjunction with other products for rosacea; however, after using twice, both times my skin was left itchy, blotchy, and irritated. Not full on allergic reaction, but irritated throughout the day/into the evening. So if you have sensitive skin/type 1 rosacea, just be aware. I know for me it is probably the AHAs in the product, sadly.

Ive been using these pore pads for about 2 months now (2-3x per week) and im pmeasantly surprised with results! For reference, my skincare routine is MINIMAL due to my skin being acne-prone and panicky when new ingredients are introduced. I use a fragrance free moisuizing bar soap for cleansing (yes I know thats terrible, but "cleansers" cause breakouts on me), these pore pads, and a ceramide moisturizer before bed (still searching for a good one for long term use itherwise I'd list it here). After 3 uses of these pore pads, me and my husband both noticed a reduction in the prominance of my nose blackheads. After 2 months, I still feel like the blackheads and pores are shrinking, albeit VERY slowly. This was not an overnight success so know that you should try it for a long period befoe making a judgement. One thing I wish Id realized before starting use was that it really does need a moisturizer to follow it. The first two times I used it I didnt follow with a moisturizer and it dried my skin WAY out. But after pausing use and moisturizing for the next few days I was able to restart using the pads (+ a moisturizer) without dryness. I am extremely prone to breakouts (one day of foundation and my clear skin is toast) and so my biggest concern was that this would break me out. It didnt. In fact, I've been using it to help clear breakouts caused by occasional makeup use. I do believe I'll be purchasing again.

extraits.titre: A STAPLE in my skin care routine
extraits.texte: I am truly surprised how these pore pads don't have 5 stars...these have been the best addition to my skincare routine. Literal game changer! My pore have significantly shrunk, my bare skin glows so well, and overall complexion is much better now. I have severely dry skin so I try to use these every other day but my skin did not have a bad reaction to them thank goodness. Honestly these make a difference within days. Please try for yourself!

Let me start off by saying I NEVER leave product reviews, but I had to for this one. I have combination skin that is breakout prone and I'm in my mid 30's. Since using this I feel I have less breakouts, my pores don't look as large as they did before, it leaves my skin super glowy, but not greasy or oily AND my skin is so smooth all over. It is the perfect pad to prep for your moisturizer. I have been using it twice a day and about a month ago added the Dermalogica acne biotic moisturizer to my routine as well. I love the combination of the two.

Be sure to test on a small area if you have sensitive skin. This product works effectively when used correctly, but it's important to do thorough research before trying it. The instructions recommending daily use are misleading; your skin needs a natural barrier to stay healthy, which includes dead skin cells. Although it may sound counterintuitive, maintaining this balance is crucial. Over-exfoliating can cause significant damage to your skin and undo the benefits you're aiming for. Personally, I recommend using it every two to three nights to avoid irritation and support skin health.
